olivia: Draft PR #6010 - small overhaul of pagination/snippet docs. Goal: concise py/ts/go examples that show resume-token checkpointing + shared retry helper. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/6010

rui: Quick pass: please ensure the Python snippet uses `async for` (modern pattern) and include a tiny sync wrapper for scripting users. Also call out token TTL.

aj: will update. Plan: py: `async for page in paginate()` + `save_checkpoint(token)`, then `sync_paginate` wrapper. ts: export `retryWithBackoff` util. go: channel-based pager + `ResumeToken` struct with `IsExpired()` method.

maria: nit: add an inline comment in each snippet: `// resume tokens expire ~15m by default` so support gets fewer TTL questions. Also fix one link to /guides/streams (was /guides/streaming).

ci-bot: snippets-harness/6010 started

ci-bot: snippets-harness/6010 failed (go): examples/pagination/go/checkpoint.go:20: undefined: ResumeToken

aj: ah I renamed locally, mismatch introduced. Pushing small patch to restore type name `ResumeToken`.

aj: patch pushed. Go snippet (trimmed):
```go
// checkpoint.go
package pagination

type ResumeToken struct {
  Cursor string "json:\"cursor\""
  ExpiresAt int64 "json:\"expires_at_unix\""
}

func (t *ResumeToken) IsExpired(now int64) bool { return now >= t.ExpiresAt }
```

maria: quick review done, left two tiny wording nits. LGTM otherwise.

olivia: thanks all. I'll merge after main pipeline goes green. Please ping if anything else pops up. :tada:
